models.title: Torch
models.description: Hand-crafted fantasy torch with layered metal wrap, carved wood grain, and a weathered iron bracket. Full PBR pipeline — colour, metalness, roughness, and normal maps baked from a high-poly sculpt.

models.title: Bow
models.description: Recurve longbow with laminated limbs, sinew wrapping, and a cord-worn grip. Focused on readable silhouette and clean edge flow for game-ready topology at hero-asset resolution.

models.title: Ornate Dagger
models.description: Ceremonial dagger with filigree crossguard, inlaid gemstone pommel, and hand-engraved blade fuller. The most texture-dense piece in the set — 4K maps capture every chased surface detail.

models.title: Shield
models.description: Kite shield with riveted iron rim, boss, and aged leather facing. Dents, scratches, and uneven paint wear are baked directly into the normal and roughness channels — no decals.

models.title: Sword
models.description: Straight-bladed arming sword with a glass-and-metal guard. The blade uses a transmission map for partial translucency, catching light along its fuller like cold crystal — visible in real-time via MeshPhysicalMaterial.

videos.title: Evening Fishing
videos.description: Atmospheric environment render — a still lakeside at dusk. Volumetric god rays through pine canopy, animated water surface via geometry nodes, and Cycles-rendered fog depth.

videos.title: Soulbound Lantern
videos.description: Hero-prop showcase with multiple lighting passes. The lantern uses EmberGen for the flame simulation and a custom IES profile for the projected light cone. Three colour variants rendered back-to-back.

images.title: Camera Icon
images.description: Clean icon render with rim lighting against a dark neutral ground. Focused on reading well at small sizes while holding detail at full resolution.

images.title: Fourteenth Study
images.description: Personal study — experimental lighting and material composition. No brief, no constraints.

images.title: Holography Study
images.description: Iridescent material exploration: layered thin-film interference, simulated with a custom holographic shader and Cycles caustics.
